summary: N2's strict archived-certificate comparison and source-byte closure checks pass review, but fully rehashed archives with conflicting duplicate raw/provenance fields and unknown snapshot/evidence fields are accepted as qualified. Four distinct boundary mutations were confirmed through the actual CLI; a same-value raw duplicate also passed, while a top-level unknown raw-run field was correctly rejected.

confirmedAcceptedCases: conflicting duplicate qualification.raw.json sourceCommit (invalid value followed by expected commit)
conflicting duplicate execution-before-archive.json attempt (invalid value followed by expected attempt)
unknown field in case evidence JSON with evidence/raw/certificate/provenance hashes refreshed
finding.negativeControl: unknown top-level raw-run field rejected by CertifyFile
finding.impact: Conflicting duplicate values are resolved by last-value decoding rather than rejected; snapshot/evidence unknown fields are ignored by permissive decoding.
